title: Extended Palette
slide_intent: Teach designers to distinguish the colors that anchor the identity from those that extend it. The distinction helps a viewer interpret variety and recognize a specific service.
strategic_value: Food-related names can tie an expanded range to shopping. Reserving Plus colors for Plus communications can distinguish that offer inside the wider brand.
demonstration: Ten labeled cards form two rows. Cashew and Carrot, Kale and Lime, Pomegranate and Guava, Cinnamon and Turmeric, and the Plus pair occupy adjacent vertical pairs.
practical_value: Choose an extended hue for a food-related context, and check its assigned role before applying a Plus hue to general communications.

content_islands.name: Palette introduction
content_islands.spec: Put the title at upper left and the explanation of supporting and Plus colors above the swatch field.

content_islands.name: Swatch matrix
content_islands.spec: Arrange the colors in five columns of two rounded cards. Give each a name and compact color references. Preserve the distinct Plus pair at the far right.
